def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    cost_of_equity = 0.08
    after_tax_cost_of_debt = 0.04
    equity_market_value = 2_000_000
    debt_market_value = 1_000_000

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    total_market_value = equity_market_value + debt_market_value
    equity_weight = equity_market_value / total_market_value
    debt_weight = debt_market_value / total_market_value

    # The stated 4% debt cost is already after tax, so the tax rate is not applied again.
    wacc = (
        equity_weight * cost_of_equity
        + debt_weight * after_tax_cost_of_debt
    )
